description: Checks the live HTTP response headers of a site's home page (one GET, https) for Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy. Returns present/missing headers with their values and a score out of 7. It does not judge the quality of the values. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_security_headers
title: Security Security Headers
